findings: THE CLOSING AT ITS GRAIN. 'Public-facing HTRC services—including data capsules, analytics algorithms, and analytics gateway login—became unavailable as of September 30, 2026.' The HTRC Analytics home page, saved for the census: 'HTRC Analytics services have ended as of September 30, 2026. HTRC accounts and logins are no longer available. HTRC Algorithms and Data Capsule services have also been discontinued.' 'Announced in October 2024, funding for the HTRC concludes at the end of 2026' agrees with 'In October 2024, HathiTrust Executive Director Mike Furlough announced that funding for the Research Center would cease at the end of 2026'; the composition does not name Furlough.

THE PRODUCT NOT CARRIED. The census row reads the center as a receiving apparatus with its product on record: derived datasets 'computed from the volumes', listed on the home page as 'Extracted Features BookNLP dataset Word frequencies Geographic locations', and 'Some HTRC resources remain available and can be used without an HTRC Analytics account'. The composition says the center 'enabled large-scale text and data mining' and names no dataset, no workset and nothing that remains; its follow-up offers 'alternative ways to access the HathiTrust Digital Library collection'.

THE POLICY NOT CARRIED. The home page lists a 'Non-consumptive use research policy', the census row's condition on the reading: whole volumes read by computer while the pages stay with the library. The composition carries no term of access.

THE FUTURE ON NO SAVED SOURCE. 'HathiTrust is reallocating resources toward emerging technologies and alternative modes of text/data access and machine learning support for its users.' Chipped to the center's page and to 'Update on HathiTrust Research Center' (June 26, 2026, 'Since the founding of the HathiTrust Research Center in 2011, HTRC staff and researchers have led highly re...'), neither saved for the census; the saved home page links 'Read about the future of the HathiTrust Research Center' without its text. Machine learning support, the one point at which the composition approaches model training, rests on a page the census has not read.
